plugins.name: computer-use
plugins.description: Windows computer-use primitives for multimodal models: DPI-exact screenshot/click/type, OCR text location, UI Automation control layer, plus a Chrome DevTools Protocol browser layer (cu.exe).

description_i18n.zh-CN: Windows 电脑操作原语工具包：截图给多模态模型直接看、DPI 精确点击/输入、OCR 找字、UI Automation 控件级操作，附 Chrome DevTools Protocol 浏览器层（cu.exe）。
